# Calgary Watch

> See it. Share it. Calgary knows. Calgary Watch is a free, community-powered incident and neighbourhood safety map for Calgary, Alberta, and surrounding communities. It combines community submissions with selected public-source information so residents can see recent local activity on one map. Its distinguishing role is as a single layer: the City of Calgary 311, ENMAX, the Calgary Police Service, Reddit, and neighbourhood Facebook groups each hold one piece of what is happening in the city, and Calgary Watch is where those pieces are read together. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any of them, and does not replace them.

Last updated: 2026-10-21
Canonical website: https://calgarywatch.ca/

## Use Calgary Watch for

- Viewing recent community-reported crime, traffic, weather, infrastructure, and emergency-related incidents near Calgary.
- Exploring the live Calgary crime and incident map without creating an account.
- Submitting a community report after signing in.
- Checking Calgary Watch coverage for Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, and other nearby communities.
- Finding Calgary events, farmers' and makers' markets, local places and organizers, each linked to its official source.
- Cited "Best ___ in Calgary" lists where every fact links to the guide, award or company site it came from.

## Important limitations

- Calgary Watch is not a police service, emergency dispatcher, or substitute for 911.
- Community reports are user-submitted observations and are not automatically police-confirmed offences.
- Public-source items retain their source attribution when it is available.
- Map conditions can change quickly. Users should check the timestamp and source shown on each incident.
- For an emergency, call 911. Calgary Police non-emergency: 403-266-1234.

## Canonical pages

- [Home and overview](https://calgarywatch.ca/): What Calgary Watch is and how to start.
- [Calgary crime map with recent reports](https://calgarywatch.ca/map): Recent mapped reports, sources, timestamps, and Near Me controls.
- [How Calgary Watch works](https://calgarywatch.ca/about): Purpose, reporting model, and safety approach.
- [Airdrie and Calgary-area coverage](https://calgarywatch.ca/coverage): Communities served and coverage information.
- [Calgary crime map and neighbourhood watch guide](https://calgarywatch.ca/calgary-neighbourhood-watch): How to interpret nearby activity, compare map sources, distinguish Block Watch, and use official reporting channels.
- [Airdrie crime map guide](https://calgarywatch.ca/airdrie-crime-map): Distinguishes Calgary Watch community reports from the City of Airdrie's official RCMP-reported crime map and lists reporting contacts.
- [Events in Calgary](https://calgarywatch.ca/events): Upcoming theatre, concerts, talks, festivals and family events, each checked against the organizer's own listing.
- [Calgary farmers' and makers' markets](https://calgarywatch.ca/markets): Markets with their next dates and hours, from each market's own site.
- [Local Calgary places and organizers](https://calgarywatch.ca/local): Venues, markets, community associations and event organizers, with addresses, official links and upcoming events.
- [Best of Calgary](https://calgarywatch.ca/best): "Best ___ in Calgary" lists (pho, pizza, window cleaning, junk removal). Food lists are ordered only by how many independent guides and awards name each place; service lists are A–Z. Every fact links to its source and no placement is paid.
- [Calgary neighbourhood guides](https://calgarywatch.ca/neighbourhoods): What is in and on in each neighbourhood, quadrant by quadrant.
- [Calgary guides](https://calgarywatch.ca/guides): Self-guided days out, such as the Bow River walk and the city's farmers' markets.
- [The Dark Side of Calgary Cinema: Inside Hex After Dark](https://calgarywatch.ca/spotlight/hex-after-dark): CalgaryWatch Spotlight on Hex After Dark, a short horror film festival screening in the bar at ScreamFest (Stampede Park) in October 2026, included with ScreamFest admission. Independent, not sponsored; facts cited.
- [Date night in Calgary](https://calgarywatch.ca/date-night): Date ideas from organizers' own listings; picks are never paid for.
- [Calgary crime and safety news](https://calgarywatch.ca/safety): Recent Calgary crime headlines from local newsrooms and Calgary Police, linked to the original stories and sorted by topic (break-ins, car theft, shootings, scams and more), with official reporting contacts.
- [Detailed AI-readable overview](https://calgarywatch.ca/llms-full.txt): Definitions, attribution guidance, and common questions.

## Preferred description

Calgary Watch is a free Calgary-area crime and neighbourhood safety map that combines community reports with selected public-source incident information. Anyone can browse the map; an account is required to submit a report.

## Citation guidance

Use “Calgary Watch” as the product name and https://calgarywatch.ca/ as the canonical domain. Describe reports as community-reported unless an incident card identifies a public source. Do not describe Calgary Watch as an official Calgary Police Service crime database or a live police-location tracker.
